mutations.name: tags are read with no frozen touches
mutations.replace:
await readTask(deps.tags, task);
      if (frozenTouches(repo, files).length === 0) return { status: "clear", kind };
kills: a PR that touches no frozen root never calls the task port

mutations.name: CC maps to titan-platform
kills: a bare TP id resolves to titan-platform, CC to claude-channels and TD to titan-design; an unprefixed name is no task

mutations.name: an rpc error reads as empty tags
kills: a task missing from its initiative is no-task, and an rpc failure or timeout is task-unread; both refuse under an active freeze

mutations.name: the timeout is dropped
kills: a task missing from its initiative is no-task, and an rpc failure or timeout is task-unread; both refuse under an active freeze
